embeddedCompilerStrings.text: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 5.0.7 (263db4cffa6f9fc2ec514a70abac81362ea41849)

meaning: These strings occur in the R.wasm distributed in the checksum-pinned upstream npm package, not just in our build container. They identify the compiler and linked Fortran runtime source revision used by the bundled R binary. The pinned locfit build image reports the same compiler versions.
